question: Will the guidance produce content-appropriate, compelling UI in the first delivery from one user prompt?
priorEvidence: Moonseed, Ricochet and Post are development examples. R4 Frostbite was a promising independent delivery with internal repairs and remaining review limits. These do not establish a general success rate.
changes: Entrypoint says the initial request includes theme, needed artwork, internal review and repair; explicit wireframes and functional spikes retain their narrower scope.
Moves live-text areas, selection/focus and stable action/status space into planning before illustrated UI construction.
Makes selected-and-focused captures plus before/after feedback evidence part of first-delivery review.
Resolves shell-first vs prove-one-complete-task sequencing and optional-vs-required game review wording.
Reviewer score 4 now needs positive visual evidence that the brief is met; functional but generic is not sufficient for an expressive game.
Three review rounds cap independent scoring, not fixing known must defects; unresolved blockers cannot be presented as finished.

scopeChecks.professionalMail: Quiet surfaces, familiar navigation and strong reading hierarchy remain valid; extra artwork is not required.
scopeChecks.textLedWordPuzzle: Typography, letter composition and response can provide character without generated imagery.
scopeChecks.smallPluginEdit: Preserve the existing direction and inspect affected states; no new visual direction or full critique loop is required.
scopeChecks.passiveHUD: Readability and changing-state checks still apply, but the guidance explicitly forbids inventing choices/actions to satisfy the process.

distribution: Installed use-facet is a symlink to this repo. Exported a fresh author kit and verified the changed consumer guides/skills match both filesystem and StudioDocs text. The kit intentionally excludes the maintainer-only device-verification guide; consumer runtime guidance contains input requirements. Final wording also exported independently to /private/tmp/facet-first-delivery-final, with both distributions checked. Frozen test kit is unchanged.

forwardTest.task: Bubble Band underwater rhythm-game song selection and ready state
forwardTest.method: Fresh context, no previous examples or parent visual coaching. Skill-required internal draft/review/repair is allowed before first delivery. Freeze submission before parent judgment.
progress: Generated performer art without parent visual coaching.
Implemented three acts, mode selection, ready result and return.
Caught and repaired initial contrast and sprite-crop issues in its own preview.
Verified Eel Electric -> Remix -> Start through pointer input; device checks and critique in progress.
First independent critique marked all five submitted views revise, including weak stage identity, unclear console focus, and clipped short-landscape action.
Builder is repairing and recapturing independently; no parent visual feedback.

Second independent critique still marked all five views revise: first repairs improved fit and focus, but surrounding controls and ready-state staging remained generic; builder continues internal repair.
forwardTest.reviewOutcome: Three independent rounds. Final verdict passed phone-ready only; four views remained revise. Builder repaired short-landscape clipping after the last verdict, without another independent verdict. Console scale concerns remained.

validation.status: Complete: 41 selected producers passed; full-gate command reports NARROWED (two deferred, three unselected). Separate local benchmark PASS; package build and status complete.
validation.firstRun: 40 selected passes; doc-style failed on two overlong instructions. Fixed and fully rerun; failure retained in validation-first-run.log.
validation.skillValidators: use-facet and critique-ui PASS on final wording
validation.package: 0.12.0; 423 instances, 412 modules. Unchanged package bytes. Nothing published.
validation.gateLimits: Reference-host benchmark and recorded native-Studio host producers are deferred. run-comparison, prove-perf-gate and prove-retained-memory were not selected.
validation.testedTree: All 14 modified tracked files match the validated working copy by SHA-256.

limits: One held-out task cannot establish a broad first-delivery success rate.
First delivery after internal iteration is not the first generated draft.
Existing exported kits need refreshed guidance; no package publication is part of this task.

changes: Scope choice/action checks to tasks that contain them, preserving passive HUDs.
Align Studio-only capture and stopping instructions with the main critique loop.
Split two overlong numbered instructions to satisfy the documentation style check.
postFreezeClarification.evidence: Counterexample and documentation-consistency review. The independent builder keeps the frozen R8 candidate; these later wording clarifications are not claimed as independently forward-tested.

parentAssessment.visual: Below the intended first-delivery quality. Charming performer art and distinct act colors sit within a largely generic menu. The broad banner, small comparison text and unused lower half weaken desktop/console composition.
parentAssessment.controls: Facet buttons provide act/mode selection and actions. Pointer/keyboard routes were reported by builder. Parent verified native D-pad/A route and exact Claw Clap / Remix accepted result; conditional pages fail to transfer focus automatically. Existing runtime guidance already requires this.
parentAssessment.devices: Builder phone sizes were simulated root bounds and environment overrides, not a native device-emulator test. Parent console capture used the actual Xbox simulator with an attached native virtual controller.
parentAssessment.firstPromptConclusion: This R8 test does not support a claim that the earlier guidance reliably reaches the desired visual finish. It motivated the separately frozen R9 whole-composition-study revision.
